title: Easy Gaps and Anvils
description: This changes the current recipes for Gaps and Anvils to a much easier recipe.
body:
This is makes the recipes for gaps and anvils much easier than the current recipes

The anvil recipe only requires one iron block being at the top middle crafting slot
The gapple recipe only requires 4 iron surrounding an apple in the the middle crafting slot

For questions: dc - isvio
